divisions.title: Wisdom's Call
divisions.theme: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge
divisions.summary: A father's instructions and Lady Wisdom's public appeal: choose the path of wisdom over folly, life over death.

divisions.title: Proverbs of Solomon
divisions.summary: Short, sharp contrasts between the wise and the foolish, the righteous and the wicked, covering work, speech, wealth, and relationships.

divisions.title: Sayings of the Wise
divisions.theme: Thirty sayings of counsel and knowledge
divisions.summary: Extended wisdom instructions warning against excess, laziness, and injustice, with practical guidance for navigating the world.

divisions.title: Hezekiah's Collection
divisions.theme: More proverbs of Solomon, copied by Hezekiah's men
divisions.summary: A second anthology from Solomon's legacy, preserved by royal scribes: kings, fools, sluggards, and the power of words.

divisions.title: Words of Agur
divisions.summary: Numerical sayings and humble confession from an outsider: every word of God proves true, and human understanding has boundaries.

divisions.title: Words of Lemuel
divisions.theme: Royal instruction and the excellent wife
divisions.summary: A queen mother's counsel to her son on justice and sobriety, concluding with the portrait of wisdom embodied in a noble woman.
